title: When a fix round's check output is byte-identical to the previous round's, flag it as a possible replay and rerun the check before spawning another implementer

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The implementer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261127-194833-6309, project ork, item S631:

When a fix round's check output is byte-identical to the previous round's, flag it as a possible replay and rerun the check before spawning another implementer

Evidence: rounds 2, 3 and 4 of ork-20261127-194833-6309 received the same daemon failure text, run id ork-20261127-205645-9e55 and 45.222s time, while the failing test passed 53 reruns
